details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: type confusion with namespace nodes in xsl:number
     - debian/patches/CVE-2019-5815.patch: reset the XPath context node
       before calling the XPath iterators in libxslt/numbers.c, add
       tests/docs/bug-218.xml, tests/general/bug-218.out,
       tests/general/bug-218.xsl.
     - CVE-2019-5815
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free of the XPath context node
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-24855.patch: restore the XPath context node
       after modifying it in libxslt/numbers.c, libxslt/templates.c and
       libxslt/xsltutils.c.
     - CVE-2025-24855
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free in xsltApplyTemplates
     - debian/patches/CVE-2021-30560.patch: stop deleting source document
       nodes when applying templates in libxslt/transform.c.
     - CVE-2021-30560
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free of excluded namespace URIs
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-55549.patch: intern excluded namespace URIs in
       the stylesheet dictionary instead of borrowing the namespace
       definition's href in libxslt/xslt.c.
     - CVE-2024-55549
